concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 3 – Scaffold split – minimum of 50 test molecules
concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) requires a **minimum of 50 test molecules** after the scaffold‑based split, but the only task that performs the split (T003) only logs a warning for test sets smaller than 20 and does not enforce the 50‑molecule minimum. This leaves the plan requirement unimplemented.

The plan specifies script paths `code/preprocessing/clean.py` and `code/preprocessing/scaffold_split.py`, yet the tasks reference different scripts (`src/preprocessing/join.py` and `src/preprocessing/graph_features.py`). No task creates the files named in the plan, so the plan’s code‑location elements are not covered.
